title.en: Who may vote, and the voters' list
title.fr: Qui peut voter, et la liste électorale

text.en: To vote in a federal election or a federal referendum, you must meet three conditions. You are a Canadian citizen. You are 18 or older on voting day. Your name is on the voters' list.
text.fr: Pour voter à une élection fédérale ou à un référendum fédéral, vous devez remplir trois conditions. Vous êtes citoyen canadien. Vous avez 18 ans ou plus le jour du vote. Votre nom figure sur la liste électorale.

source.quote: You are eligible to vote in a federal election or cast a ballot in a federal referendum if you are: • a Canadian citizen; and • at least 18 years old on voting day; and • on the voters’ list.

verification.evidence: You are eligible to vote in a federal election or cast a ballot in a federal referendum if you are: • a Canadian citizen; and • at least 18 years old on voting day; and • on the voters’ list.

text.en: A person who can vote in federal elections can also vote in a federal referendum.
text.fr: Une personne qui peut voter aux élections fédérales peut aussi voter lors d'un référendum fédéral.

verification.evidence: You are eligible to vote in a federal election or cast a ballot in a federal referendum if you are: • a Canadian citizen; and • at least 18 years old on voting day; and • on the voters’ list.

text.en: Elections Canada is a neutral agency of Parliament. It makes the voters' lists for federal elections and referendums, using the National Register of Electors.
text.fr: Élections Canada est un organisme neutre du Parlement. Il dresse les listes électorales des élections et des référendums fédéraux à partir du Registre national des électeurs.

source.quote: The voters’ lists used during federal elections and referendums are produced from the National Register of Electors by a neutral agency of Parliament called Elections Canada.

verification.evidence: The voters’ lists used during federal elections and referendums are produced from the National Register of Electors by a neutral agency of Parliament called Elections Canada.

text.en: The National Register of Electors is a permanent database. It lists Canadian citizens aged 18 or older who have the right to vote in federal elections and referendums.
text.fr: Le Registre national des électeurs est une base de données permanente. On y trouve les citoyens canadiens de 18 ans ou plus qui ont le droit de voter aux élections et aux référendums fédéraux.

source.quote: This is a permanent database of Canadian citizens 18 years of age or older who are qualified to vote in federal elections and referendums.

verification.evidence: The voters’ lists used during federal elections and referendums are produced from the National Register of Electors by a neutral agency of Parliament called Elections Canada. This is a permanent database of Canadian citizens 18 years of age or older who are qualified to vote in federal elections and referendums.

text.en: When an election is called, Elections Canada mails a voter information card to every elector in the National Register of Electors. The card tells you when and where to vote. It also gives a number to call if you need an interpreter or other special help.
text.fr: Quand une élection est déclenchée, Élections Canada envoie par la poste une carte d'information de l'électeur à chaque électeur inscrit au Registre national des électeurs. La carte indique quand et où voter. Elle donne aussi un numéro à appeler si vous avez besoin d'un interprète ou d'un autre service spécial.

source.quote: Once an election has been called, Elections Canada mails a voter information card to each elector whose name is in the National Register of Electors. The card lists when and where you vote and the number to call if you require an interpreter or other special services.

verification.evidence: Once an election has been called, Elections Canada mails a voter information card to each elector whose name is in the National Register of Electors. The card lists when and where you vote and the number to call if you require an interpreter or other special services.

text.en: Maybe you chose not to be in the National Register of Electors, or no voter information card came to you. It is not too late: your name can go onto the voters' list whenever you need, even on election day.
text.fr: Vous avez peut-être choisi de ne pas figurer au Registre national des électeurs, ou vous n'avez reçu aucune carte d'information de l'électeur. Il n'est pas trop tard : votre nom peut être inscrit sur la liste électorale quand vous en avez besoin, même le jour de l'élection.

source.quote: Even if you choose not to be listed in the National Register of Electors or do not receive a voter information card, you can still be added to the voters’ list at any time, including on election day.

verification.evidence: Even if you choose not to be listed in the National Register of Electors or do not receive a voter information card, you can still be added to the voters’ list at any time, including on election day.

text.en: Whether you vote on election day or at an advance poll, go to the polling station shown on your voter information card.
text.fr: Que vous votiez le jour de l'élection ou par anticipation, rendez-vous au bureau de scrutin indiqué sur votre carte d'information de l'électeur.

source.quote: To vote either on election day or at advance polls, go to the polling station listed on your voter information card.

verification.evidence: To vote either on election day or at advance polls, go to the polling station listed on your voter information card.
